<ParamField body="action" type="ReactNode">
  Optional trailing ReactNode. InlineBanner.Action supplies the shared banner action preset and inherits the resolved banner color; arbitrary controls are also accepted.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="children" type="ReactNode">
  Caller-provided content. Standard plain strings truncate with a focusable tooltip; rich nodes render directly. Compact content wraps.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="className" type="string">
  Class merged onto the root div or composed element.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="color" type="&quot;blue&quot; | &quot;gray&quot; | &quot;green&quot; | &quot;orange&quot; | &quot;red&quot;" default="status palette">
  Gray, blue, green, orange or red palette override. An omitted color follows status.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="embedded" type="boolean" default="false">
  Removes the standard bottom margin. Compact layouts have no bottom margin.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="icon" type="ReactNode" default="decorative information icon">
  Leading ReactNode. Defaults to a decorative information icon. Pass null to omit it.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="layout" type="&quot;compact&quot; | &quot;standard&quot;" default="standard">
  Standard full-width layout or compact wrapping layout with a 512px maximum content width. Defaults to standard.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="ref" type="Ref&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;">
  Ref to the root div, or to the DOM element supplied through render.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="render" type="ReactElement&lt;unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor&lt;any&gt;&gt; | ComponentRenderFn&lt;HTMLProps, BannerState&gt;">
  Base UI root element or render callback, receiving native props/ref and resolved Banner state.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="status" type="&quot;error&quot; | &quot;info&quot; | &quot;neutral&quot; | &quot;success&quot; | &quot;warning&quot;" default="info">
  Feedback meaning: neutral, info, success, warning or error. Defaults to info. Roles and announcements remain caller-owned.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="style" type="CSSProperties">
  Inline styles applied to the root div or composed element.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="variant" type="&quot;soft&quot; | &quot;solid&quot;" default="soft">
  Solid or soft appearance, independently of status and layout. Defaults to soft.
</ParamField>

### InlineBanner.Action

<ParamField body="Action.className" type="string | ((state: ButtonState) =&gt; string | undefined)">
  CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
  returns a class based on the component's state.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.elevated" type="boolean">
  Adds a shadow and backdrop blur. Neutral outline buttons also use elevated surface colors.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.endIcon" type="ReactNode">
  Decorative content displayed after the label.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.focusableWhenDisabled" type="boolean" default="false">
  Whether the button should be focusable when disabled.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.fullWidth" type="boolean">
  Expands the button to fill its container width.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.href" type="string">
  Destination URL. Enables native link semantics instead of button semantics.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.loading" type="boolean">
  Shows a loading indicator and disables activation while preserving the button width.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.render" type="ReactElement&lt;unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor&lt;any&gt;&gt; | ComponentRenderFn&lt;HTMLProps, ButtonState&gt;">
  Caller-supplied root element or renderer. Preserve a native button, or an anchor when `href` is set. Router integration belongs to the caller.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.shortcut" type="ShortcutDefinition">
  Flat key array for simultaneous keys, or nested key arrays for an ordered sequence. Displayed on non-mobile screens.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.shortcutJoinLabel" type="string">
  Localized text between sequence steps. Defaults to then.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.startIcon" type="ReactNode">
  Decorative content displayed before the label.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.style" type="CSSProperties | ((state: ButtonState) =&gt; CSSProperties | undefined)">
  Style applied to the element, or a function that
  returns a style object based on the component's state.
</ParamField>
